QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) zeroes a static `heap` context, then installs its own allocator through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. ... It is the only library code that calls the setter."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as installing itself via the runtime setter and states it is the only library code calling it.
